query: SELECT count(*) AS "payments!",coalesce(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.amount_minor),0)::bigint AS "p95!" FROM payment_attempts p WHERE p.tenant=$1 AND p.currency=$2 AND p.environment='live' AND p.state IN ('captured','captured_late') AND p.capture_confirmed_at>now()-interval '30 days'
